## BIG THINGS HAPPENING
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

big_things <- rmarkdown::metadata$'big-things'

# Check if big_things exists and has content
if (!is.null(big_things) && any(nzchar(unlist(big_things)))) {
  items <- unlist(big_things)
  items <- items[nzchar(trimws(items))]
  
  cat('<ul>\n')
  for (item in items) {
    cat(paste0('  <li>', item, '</li>\n'))
  }
  cat('</ul>\n')
}
```

## ANNOUNCEMENTS

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

announcements <- rmarkdown::metadata$announcements

# Check if announcements are defined in the YAML and have content
if (!is.null(announcements) && any(nzchar(unlist(announcements)))) {
  items <- unlist(announcements)
  items <- items[nzchar(trimws(items))]
  
  cat('<ul>\n')
  for (item in items) {
    cat(paste0('  <li>', item, '</li>\n'))
  }
  cat('</ul>\n')
} else {
  # Fallback for older posts to include the div from the parent .qmd file
  cat('{{< contents announcements >}}')
}
```
